What is limine-mkinitcpio-hook?

This package hooks limine-entry-tool into mkinitcpio so that installing, updating, or removing a kernel automatically regenerates the corresponding Limine bootloader entry, including unified kernel images and fallback images. It writes and prunes entries by machine-id and periodically backs up limine.conf, removing the need to hand-edit boot configuration after a kernel update.

Install limine-mkinitcpio-hook on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add limine-mkinitcpio-hook

Good to know

  • Limine bootloader version 8 or newer
  • A FAT32 EFI/boot partition with at least 1 GiB free
  • mkinitcpio-based kernel install workflow
  • efibootmgr for UEFI systems
